Akeal Hosein was greeted with a boundary off the very first ball before CSK pulled things back with a couple of quiet overs. Nissanka then took the attack to Mukesh- cracking a boundary and following it up with a maximum. Mukesh however-had the last laugh as a well-disguised slower delivery accounted for Nissanka. There was a change of ends for Akeal Hosein and he made an immediate impact by removing a struggling KL. Delhi Capitals closed the power play at 37 for 2.
